metadata.case_name: LAI WAI TAN PETER v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE ACTING FOR HONG KONG POLICE FORCE

plaintiff.occupation_before: senior police constable (police officer attached to Tai Po Police Station)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: security guard or a taxi driver

injuries.description: soft tissue injury at the neck region
source: The Plaintiff had soft tissue injury at the neck and back region. There was no significant injury such as fracture, dislocation or spinal instability (or radioculopathy).
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: soft tissue injury at the back region
source: The Plaintiff had soft tissue injury at the neck and back region. There was no significant injury such as fracture, dislocation or spinal instability (or radioculopathy).
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: reduced ability to cope with high demand of physical strength (compromised ability for outdoor police duties)
